long_biography.plain_text:
Gulbakhor Burkhanovna Ismailova is a retired gynaecologist who has said she was born, raised and worked throughout her medical career in Tashkent. Public records identify her as the sister of industrialist Alisher Usmanov. Unlike her brother, she has no documented fortune-building business career; her public financial profile instead comes from family trusts and holding companies associated with assets transferred within the family.

U.S. and European authorities identified both siblings with The Sister Trust and historically described Ismailova as the beneficiary behind the chain owning Dilbar. That history explains the yacht connection but does not establish present control. Her representatives said in 2024 that she had irrevocably excluded herself from future trust benefits. In 2026, a German court found insufficient evidence that Usmanov controlled The Sister Trust, while reporting described Ismailova as its former principal beneficiary. Her current economic interest therefore remains unresolved in public evidence.
